name: context-handoff-cutover
description: Tier-P F1 scenario: on a fresh box, install the live-cutover trio (agent-worktrees + agent-dispatch + context-handoff) and assert the handoff-cutover ROBUSTNESS contract from GitHub issue #853. (1) Seed invariant: the shipped context-handoff `cutover-seed.mjs` builds a BASH-FIRST task-cutover seed -- the successor's first action is a core `bash` command chain (agent-dispatch consume --defer-complete && agent-worktrees conclude-session && agent-worktrees handoff-cutover --retire-pane), NOT the `consume_handoff` extension tool -- so the successor cannot be orphaned by the CLI's startup extension-reload race; file-backed / unknown-pane handoffs correctly fall back to the tool-based seed. (2) Verbs are real: the three CLI verbs the bash-first seed relies on exist on a fresh install. (3) Mechanism (best-effort, needs tmux): the retire verb actually retires a live mux pane. Name-free / public.

provisioned_by_flow: tmux (apt, best-effort for the mechanism phase)

stages.title: the bash-first seed's CLI verbs are real
mechanism: retire verb kills a live mux pane (best-effort)
